assets.service: process steam generation and feedwater deaeration

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during cleaning and preparation on D-8210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on D-8210 and TT-8210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating hot and steam systems, specifically preventing water ingress to hot material. D-8210 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 1 May 2026 a regulatory notice was issued concerning D-8210 and TT-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station following cleaning and preparation.
